record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare DREAM_EATER (catalog passive NONE). The strategy is shared; differences are star count and stats. The ability has two mutually exclusive branches depending on whether ANY enemy on the board is asleep when it is cast.
record.summary: Two branches, chosen by scanning the whole board (row by row) for the first enemy that is asleep. (1) If one exists: the caster moves to a random nearest empty orthogonal neighbour cell of that sleeper (Manhattan distance 1) if one is free, then deals SPECIAL damage (requested 45/90/150/250 by stars) to that sleeper - not necessarily the unit the caster was targeting - and requests a heal equal to 1 x the takenDamage that call returned. (2) If no enemy is asleep: it looks for any enemy that can be put to sleep (checking the cast target first, then enemies in board order, requiring no Rune Protect, not skydiving, no IMMUNITY_SLEEP effect and ccCooldown <= 0); if such an enemy exists it requests sleep on the CAST TARGET (not on the enemy that was found), for [3000, 4000, 5000, 6000] ms by stars x (1 + caster AP/100) rounded, and sets the caster's PP to maxPP so the next ability gate is satisfied immediately (the PP spent by the base class is refunded); no damage and no heal in this branch. If nobody can be put to sleep, nothing happens and the PP stays spent. The sleep request still passes triggerSleep's own guards on the cast target (already asleep, Rune Protect, skydiving, IMMUNITY_SLEEP, ccCooldown), so the PP refill can happen without any sleep being applied when the cast target is the unit that fails the guards while another enemy qualifies. Requested raw numbers: DROWZEE (1 star) 45 damage / 3000 ms; HYPNO (2 stars) 90 damage / 4000 ms.

targeting.who: branch 1: the first sleeping enemy found scanning the board by rows (y, then x), anywhere on the board; branch 2: the cast target passed to the strategy (the sleep is requested on it), after a candidate check that includes other enemies
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; target selection before the cast was not read.

geometry.shape: single target; branch 1 also relocates the caster
geometry.movement: caster swaps into a random one of the nearest empty cells within Manhattan distance 1 of the sleeper; no move if none is free (the damage still happens)

effects.scaling: requested raw amount; AP: x (1 + caster AP/100) (apBoost explicitly true); the cast's crit factor only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: applied change: blocked by protect / skydiving / magicBounce on the sleeper (takenDamage 0, so no heal); otherwise handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1, then shield, Shiny Charm, Fossil and Cover Band branches fix takenDamage (rounded). The hit shortens the sleeper's remaining sleep by 300 ms (each damage instance received); the sleeper is not woken outright by this source.

effects.scaling: 1 x takenDamage returned by handleSpecialDamage; apBoost 0 and crit false are passed, so neither AP nor crit scales it
effects.resolution: handleHeal then applies: a wounded caster receives no HP heal (with Blood Moon weather and a Blood Stone held by the caster's player a shield of round(0.3 x stones x heal) is requested instead); nothing for a caster at 0 hp or protected; x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH weather; rounded and capped at missing HP; overheal on a GRASS-synergy unit adds 0.4 x overheal max HP. takenDamage 0 requests a heal of 0.

effects.scaling: duration = round(base x (1 + caster AP/100)) computed in the strategy (not through an apBoost parameter); no crit scaling
effects.resolution: applied duration: triggerSleep on the cast target then applies, in order, weather (NIGHT x1.3, ZENITH x0.7), enraged /2, then SWIFT_SWIM x0.7 (else HYDRATION x0.5, else WATER_VEIL or SURGE_SURFER x0.3), then Odd Keystone x(1 - 0.1 x count held by the target's player), rounded. It is skipped if the target already sleeps, has Rune Protect, is skydiving, has IMMUNITY_SLEEP or has ccCooldown above 0 (1500 ms after a sleep ends). A Chesto Berry on the target is eaten when sleep starts. Each damage instance received shortens it by 300 ms.

pokemon.pp = maxPP whenever a candidate that can sleep was found, whether or not the sleep request on the cast target then succeeded; with the base-class cost already paid, the net PP after the cast is full.

statusEffects.applicationOrder: after the candidate search; PP refilled afterwards
statusEffects.guards: triggerSleep: not already asleep, not Rune Protect, not skydiving, not IMMUNITY_SLEEP, ccCooldown <= 0
statusEffects.combatEffect: a sleeping unit cannot move or act except with the COMATOSE passive (canMove / state checks); sleep ends when the cooldown runs out and gives 1500 ms of crowd-control immunity

starBehavior.note: both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3- and 4-star values (150/250 damage, 5000/6000 ms) are not reachable by the two units' bare star counts. maxPP 100 and range 2 for both.

record.positionalConditions: Branch 1 ignores range and the cast target: it uses the first sleeping enemy anywhere on the board in row-major order and teleports (swaps) the caster next to it when a free orthogonal neighbour exists. Branch 2 works on the cast target.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Branch 2 refills PP, so the next cast is possible as soon as the base gate is met and, if the target is still asleep, takes branch 1. Branch 1 leaves PP at 0.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested (raw): 45 / 90 damage, 3000 / 4000 ms sleep, heal 1 x takenDamage. Applied: damage x (1 + AP/100) [x crit], / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF) ceil min 1, shield accounting (takenDamage is shield part + HP part, 0 if blocked or Shiny Charm, + Fossil addition, or the cover ally's result); heal passes the handleHeal modifiers and the missing-HP cap; sleep duration x (1 + AP/100) then weather, enraged, duration reductions and the triggerSleep guards (the sleep can be refused while the PP refill still happens).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers) - only SPE_DEF division, ceil/min 1 and the takenDamage branches were located
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
How a sleeping unit is treated by targeting and attack states beyond the canMove/canCast checks (the other sleep sites in attacking-state / movement were only listed, not read)
unresolved: The source reads as if the sleep is meant for targetThatCanSleep but is applied to the cast target; this record states what the code does and does not know the intent
Whether the entity damage-received function containing the 300 ms sleep reduction runs for every damage source including SPECIAL ability damage (its name and callers were not read)
Resurrection paths other than the cited branches and other death-cancelling effects on the sleeper were not enumerated
Whether any other item or synergy effect changes DREAM_EATER beyond what is listed
Both units have passive NONE; no routing uncertainty in the queue record; not probed and not a fight; source reading only
